people_ops_anna: Following up from today's all-hands pricing segment  leadership said they'd hang out here for clarifying Qs on packaging, quotas, credits. Drop quick ones here please.

eng_raj: Question  in our sandbox we share one project key across feature branches. If branchA spikes, will it starve branchB?

cto_jen: Yes if you share a single project key both branches consume the same project-level quota. You can either create separate projects per branch/feature or enable org-level quotas for global control.

sre_olivia: Are rate limits windowed by second/minute/day? What's the granularity we should instrument for alerts?

cto_jen: We enforce multiple windows: per-second concurrency and per-minute token throughput; also daily token quotas for billing tiers. Instrument at the per-minute level for throughput alerts and per-second for concurrency-sensitive paths (e.g., streaming).

finance_john: Clarify on credits: trial credits are non-transferable between projects, but enterprise promo credits can be applied org-wide if requested during redemption.

eng_raj: If a test job is causing 429s in CI, is there any auto-retry/backoff guidance?

product_maya: Recommend exponential backoff with jitter; the SDKs include a retry helper that respects Retry-After headers. For heavy background jobs, consider rate-limited batching or a dedicated project.

people_ops_anna: How long will the existing tiers be supported after the Developer SKU consolidation?

cto_jen: Existing customers are grandfathered on current quotas/pricing for 6 months after the change. We'll send targeted emails and in-console notices 30/14/7 days before any change.

eng_raj: Any idea when the FAQ will be up?

product_maya: We aim to publish Monday EOD with examples: CLI usage, project vs org quota examples, and how-to for burst credits.

sre_olivia: If an account gets flagged for abuse detection will that throttle all projects under the org or just the offending project key?

cto_jen: Usually the offending project is rate-limited; in severe cases we may apply org-level mitigations while investigating. We try to notify account owners via email and Console alerts.

support_bot: [billing-bot] Reminder: promo credits expiring soon will show a banner on Console home; check Billing -> Credits.

people_ops_anna: Thanks all  I'll close this thread after QA and paste the FAQ link here. :raised_hands:
